import Lean.Util.CollectAxioms
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linter.Lint

/-! # External declaration and axiom checks for canonical surface descent -/

open Lean Elab Command Batteries.Tactic.Lint in
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let env ← getEnv
  let modules : Array Name := #[
    `DifferentialGeometry.Topology.PiecewiseLinear.PLAnnulusBoundary,
    `DifferentialGeometry.Topology.PiecewiseLinear.CanonicalComponentDeletion,
    `DifferentialGeometry.Topology.PiecewiseLinear.CanonicalReturningAnnulusDeletion,
    `DifferentialGeometry.Topology.PiecewiseLinear.CanonicalReturningComponentDeletion,
    `DifferentialGeometry.Topology.PiecewiseLinear.CanonicalReturningWindowReduction]
  let declarations := env.constants.map₁.fold (init := #[]) fun names name _ =>
    match env.getModuleIdxFor? name with
    | some idx =>
      if modules.contains env.header.moduleNames[idx]! && !env.isAutoDecl name then
        names.push name else names
    | none => names
  for target in modules do
    unless declarations.any (fun name =>
      match env.getModuleIdxFor? name with
      | some idx => env.header.moduleNames[idx]! == target
      | none => false) do
      throwError m!"No nonautomatic declarations found for {target}"
  let allowed := #[`propext, `Classical.choice, `Quot.sound]
  for name in declarations do
    let axioms ← Lean.collectAxioms name
    let bad := axioms.filter fun axiomName => !allowed.contains axiomName
    unless bad.isEmpty do
      throwError m!"Non-foundational axioms {bad.toList} in {name}"
  let checks ← getChecks true none none
  let checks := checks.filter fun check =>
    check.name != `docBlame && check.name != `docBlameThm
  unless checks.size == 13 do
    throwError m!"Expected 13 declaration linters; found {checks.size}"
  for check in checks do
    for name in declarations do
      if let some message ← check.test name then
        logError m!"{check.name}: {name}: {message}"
